focus_candidate.requirement: Make the supported rejection of a constructible array at print depth 1000 reachable from the read target.

focus_candidate.alternative_paths: All selected print variants use print_value. Neither flag choices, permitted trailing input, nor the later minify call construct or deepen the tree.

assessment.target_route: Four valid flag bytes and a NUL-terminated JSON payload → cJSON_ParseWithOpts → selected print variant → print_value → print_array.
assessment.failure_condition: A constructed chain of 1001 arrays would reach the print_array depth-1000 rejection if the effective limit is 1000. The old entry prints only its parser result, and parsing rejects the 1001st container at that limit.
assessment.alternative_paths: The selected print variants share print_value. The entry does not construct or deepen a tree; its later minify operation works on a copy of the input text. The effective build limit is still unknown.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The public constructor can create an array node for a finite deep tree.
The public add operation can attach child arrays without a depth check.
Parsing rejects an array at the configured nesting limit.
Print dispatch routes array nodes to print_array.
The supplied header excerpt defines the limit as 1000, subject to the unresolved effective build setting.
